summary: At turn 51 of a chat, a rule is ignored although the window is only 20 percent full. You build a context builder that fills the window by importance within a token budget (rules and question, then the best sources, then the newest history), reports what it dropped, and refuses an impossible budget, and you decide what to include for three situations.
goal: Fill a context window within a token budget by priority, and say what you drop and why.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: add context.py, run show_context.py and match the four budget lines
Step 2: try budgets 700 and 1000, predict the dropped turns, then check
Step 3: run a budget of 150, read the error and decide what a real app should do
Step 4: fill in the include, leave out and why table for three situations, and write the five tests
Play the Window Planner game to the end and see your score
